scientific_integrity: The two cited primary papers establish the hypersimplex setting and general Gaussian spherical-width methods. The present claim is limited to its explicit cross-rank covariance kernel and unique sign transition, both supported by a complete mathematical proof. Bibliographic uniqueness and independent mathematical validation are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Canonical Euclidean hypersimplices, fixed proportional ranks, and one common Haar-uniform direction only. No shrinking-rank theorem or affine-invariant statement. Numerical simulations verify finite sanity checks but cannot prove an asymptotic limit.
title: A sharp sign reversal in cross-rank spherical widths of hypersimplices
